doc: compare(gen, ref) from the two measure dicts (inputs: gen_zonal_lat, gen_zonal, gen_hist and ref_zonal_lat, ref_zonal, ref_hist, the keys of measure()): zonal_rmse = sqrt(mean((gen.zonal - ref.zonal)^2)) over the bands with |gen.zonal_lat| < 70 (strict; the latitudes come from the GENERATED dict and ref_zonal_lat is never read), hist_l1 = sum |gen.hist - ref.hist|; returned here as [zonal_rmse, hist_l1]. Float64 arithmetic on lists: 1e-9. A NaN band (an empty latitude band) inside the selection poisons the mean: zonal_rmse is NaN, hist_l1 is 0 (np.mean does not skip NaN).
